title: LibriSpeech OpenSLR 12 small development subsets

version.label: SLR12 dev clean and dev other

citation: Panayotov, Vassil et al. LibriSpeech: An ASR Corpus Based on Public Domain Audio Books. ICASSP 2015.

licence.attribution_text: Cite Panayotov et al., LibriSpeech, ICASSP 2015, and retain CC BY 4.0 attribution.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Keep selected subsets privately with attribution and never commit or rehost the recordings.

population.description: Seventy three audiobook readers represented in the official LibriSpeech dev clean and dev other subsets.
limitations: Audiobook reading is not the controlled isolated word task.
The corpus has no human phone production labels.
The population does not establish Australian or product task performance.

annotation.provenance: Official utterance transcripts and speaker separated audio, without human phone production annotation.
limitations: Transcripts can test runtime and ordinary ASR or alignment behavior only.

inspected_materials: Official OpenSLR landing page and md5sum.txt inspected.
dev-clean and dev-other archives verified against official MD5 checksums.
Archive speaker paths audited without extracting audio.
findings: The selected subsets contain 73 unique speakers.
No speaker appears in both selected subsets.
Private deterministic participant assignments retain original subset as an aggregate stratum.

participant_split.source_split_provenance: The selected official development subsets contain disjoint speaker identifiers.
participant_split.project_strategy: Stable SHA256 order inside dev clean and dev other strata, then exact 60 percent development, 20 percent tuning and 20 percent held out.

lineage.duplicate_detection: Private speaker and utterance ids are checked before benchmark assembly.
